Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not give my name on a recording if that's okay. You have my policy and claim information.
Q: That's fine. Can you describe where you were when the collision happened?
A: I was in the parking lot of a grocery store here in Houston, driving slowly toward an open space near the front
entrance.
Q: What were the weather and lighting conditions?
A: It was dry and still daylight, maybe late afternoon. The lot was fairly busy.
Q: Tell me what you saw right before the impact.
A: A silver sedan was backing out of a space on my right. I braked, but he kept coming and his rear bumper hit my
front driver's side corner.
Q: Did you have any contact with the other vehicle before the impact?
A: No, I didn't touch anything else. I'd come to a near stop when it happened.
Q: How fast would you estimate you were going?
A: Maybe five or ten miles an hour. I wasn't rushing.
Q: Did you hit your head or lose consciousness?
A: My head hit the side window hard. I didn't black out completely, but I was dazed for a few minutes.
Q: How are you feeling now?
A: I've had headaches, sensitivity to light, and I get tired by the afternoon. My doctor has told me I have a concussion
and I've been limiting screen time and resting.
Q: Have you received any treatment since the collision?
A: Yes, I was seen at an urgent care clinic that day and I have a follow-up with a neurologist scheduled.
Q: Is there anything else you want to add?
A: Only that I'm cooperating fully and I'd like updates on the repair estimate for my vehicle.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
